sophie: Incoming support ticket: acct=847219 blocked at trial signup. Frontend returned 'trial_on_hold' when user tried to redeem promo STARTER2026. Email looks like mike@tempmail.biz and IP resolves to cloud host.
alex: can you paste the signup payload/logs? need ua, ip, and risk signals.
fraud-bot: automated checks: disposable_email=high, vpn_detected=medium, device_rotation=high, promo_abuse_score=0.71, same_ip_recent_creations=4/48h. ASN: 134217728 (cloud provider).
maya: signup payload (redacted):
```
account_id: 847219
email: mike@tempmail.biz
promo: STARTER2026
ip: 203.0.113.45
ua: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7)
fingerprint: a3f4c2b7
```
maya: ops options: 1) request stronger verification (SMS/KBA) or 2) manual limited trial + monitoring. which do we prefer?
alex: customer says they're a legit startup dev and asked for manual override to test integration. is there an internal compliance issue with granting a short trial behind verification?
jordan: if we grant, suggest: 7-day trial, token cap 25k, strict rate limits, disable prompt export until cleared.
sophie: they offered phone verif. provided +1-415-555-0192. can we SMS and then consider manual approve?
maya: SMS verification acceptable. After verification we can set manual_review=approved_by_support, trial=7d_25k_tokens, watchlist flag. will annotate audit log.
alex: sending SMS code now :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sophie: customer returned with code screenshot and confirmed. phone WHOIS check lines up with company domain contact :white_check_mark:
fraud-bot: re-eval after phone verification: disposable_email still high, vpn_detected persists, overall_score=0.48.
maya: proceeding with manual override. ops patch to apply:
```
PATCH /internal/accounts/847219
body: { "manual_review": "approved_sophie", "trial_grant": "7d_25k_tokens", "notes": "manual override after SMS verification; monitor for abuse" }
```
alex: applied override, 200 OK. Trial active. setting alert rules and watchlist.
sophie: customer confirms API calls are working again. closing ticket pending monitoring.
jordan: add acct to weekly walkthroughs and a 3-check schedule this week for anomalous prompting or export attempts.
maya: added to list: manual-trials-watchlist; scheduled three checks and will escalate to security on anomalies.
alex: product note: STARTER2026 seems targeted by transient cloud IPs. recommend adding anti-abuse throttling on promo apply endpoint and consider hcaptcha for high-risk flows.
sophie: thanks team 389 - resolved for now.
